sentence: A turn-based memory game where each person watches a growing pattern of four shapes and repeats it, and the longest streak wins.
use_when: The group wants a quick casual game to play in chat
People want to compare memory skills by taking turns
Someone asks for a simple game with scores and a winner
dont_use_when: The group needs a two-player board game like chess or tic-tac-toe
People want to vote or collect opinions, which needs a poll
Players need to act at the same time in real time
